sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM)

The captioned appeal is by the Insurance Company questioning the liability fastened on the Insurance Company on the premise that there is breach of policy conditions and therefore, the present appeal is filed contending that the Insurance Company needs to be exonerated of the liability to pay the amount determined by the Tribunal on the ground of breach of policy conditions.
NC: 2024:KHC-K:8406 2.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the Insurance company and the learned counsel appearing for the claimant.

3. The issue in regard to liability of insurance company in the event it is found that there is breach of policy conditions by the owner of the vehicle is no more resintegra and the same is given quietus by the Full Bench of this Court in the case of New India Assurance Co., Ltd., vs Yallavva W/O Yamanappa Dharnakeri1 4.

entities.text: New India Assurance Co., Ltd., vs Yallavva W/O Yamanappa Dharnakeri1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the light of the law laid down by the Full Bench of this Court, this Court is of the view that even if breach is substantiated by the Insurance Company, the primary duty to satisfy the compensation lies squarely on the Insurance Company.

5. For the reasons stated supra, this Court proceeds to pass the following:
AIR Online 2020 KAR 986 NC: 2024:KHC-K:8406 ORDER (i) The appeal is allowed in part.
(ii) The impugned judgment and award passed by the Tribunal in MVC.No.499/2015 is hereby modified.
